question: Break down the off-thread 61pp far enough for A to aim at it. GPU 23.9 and compositor 12.5 on a canvas chart smells like raster or layer promotion.
verdict: It is raster, and there is no evidence of a cached/promoted layer. The chart re-rasters and re-presents every frame while producing ~124 frames/sec, and every frame also costs a full style recalc and layout. 11.0 ms of CPU per presented frame across all threads, 6.0 ms of it on the main thread.
surface: deployed, dist-v9 shell, single panel (mcLayout=1), replay playing at 60x, 10s trace

instrument.added: Per-thread top events by SELF time (selfTimeByEventName). Trace 'X' events nest strictly, so a parent's own cost is its duration minus its direct children's. Summing raw durations would have credited RunTask with everything it contains and named nothing — the same class of error as the m20Q6 wrapper in W75.
instrument.tests: scripts/tests/cpu-thread-census.test.mjs, 16 unit, including nested/sibling/partial-overlap self time

frameRate.evidence: DXGISwapChainImageBacking::Present x1244, MainFrame.Draw x1244, LocalFrameView::performLayout x1245, DawnSharedContext::FlushD3D11Commands x1244, GpuChannelHost::VerifyFlush x1244 — all one per frame.
frameRate.caveat: Headless Chrome may not be vsync-capped, so treat 124 fps as an upper bound rather than what the PO's display does. The per-frame COMPOSITION below is the structural finding and does not depend on the absolute rate.
frameRate.consistencyCheck: Frame-proportional costs at 60 Hz instead of 124 would put the total near ~105% of a core, which brackets the PO's 111%.

breakdown.note: compositor layer tree rebuilt every frame
a synchronous flush verify per frame

FunctionCall.reading: product JavaScript — half the main-thread cost, 3.0 calls per frame at ~1.0 ms each

mainThreadShape.renderingRemainder: ~17pp of the main thread is style + layout + paint + compositor-update, all frame-proportional.

namedTargetsForManagerA.evidence: 1244 presents in 10 s (~124/s) with one layout, one compositor-tree update and one present each.
namedTargetsForManagerA.cut: Coalesce replay-driven redraws into one rAF per frame. Roughly half of the 62pp off-thread cost is directly proportional to frame count.

namedTargetsForManagerA.target: Per-frame style recalc and layout on a canvas chart
namedTargetsForManagerA.evidence: Document::recalcStyle x1946 and LocalFrameView::performLayout x1245 in 10 s; a canvas redraw needs neither.
namedTargetsForManagerA.cut: Find the DOM/CSS mutated every frame (price-axis labels, legend, crosshair readouts are the usual suspects) and write them without invalidating style or layout.
Something inserts or edits a stylesheet roughly every second frame. A rule-set change invalidates style globally, which is why recalcStyle runs more than once per frame.

namedTargetsForManagerA.evidence: GPU cost is raster command deserialize + flush (4660 each per 10 s), not shader work; PaintArtifactCompositor::Update runs every frame and 20.4 paint records are produced per frame.
namedTargetsForManagerA.cut: This is the raster answer to the Director's question, and the absence of a stable promoted layer is the reason. Promote the chart canvas so unchanged content composites instead of re-rastering.

notClaimed: This is one 10 s window on one machine, headless. The thread shares were stable across the three W77 runs (total 133.88/139.53/134.47), but the absolute frame rate should be re-checked on a vsync-capped display before sizing any fix.
